---
title: "Traffic Speed Deflectometer (TSD)"
---

This section brings together work on Traffic Speed Deflectometer (TSD) measurement fundamentals, pavement response under moving loads, deflection velocity and slope, slope integration, backcalculation, full-truck modeling, and flexible- and rigid-pavement applications.

## Technical Articles

### [TSD-01 — Four TSD Myths: Confirmed, Busted, or Plausible?](../posts/tsd-four-myths/index.qmd)

Four common assumptions about Traffic Speed Deflectometer analysis are examined through moving-load mechanics, including FWD–TSDD correlation, slope integration, vehicle-model simplification, and slope-based backcalculation.

### [DS-01 — DSteele: A 3D Spectral-Element Model for Pavement Response under Moving Loads](../posts/dsteele-overview/index.qmd)

Development history, engineering motivation, implementation, early evaluation, and application of DSteele to moving-load and TSD analysis.

### [DS-02 — Mathematical Formulation of DSteele](../posts/dsteele-mathematical-formulation/index.qmd)

Mathematical foundation of DSteele, including the transformed-domain moving-load formulation, finite-layer and halfspace stiffness matrices, and direct calculation of pavement surface deflection and longitudinal deflection slope for TSD applications.

## Additional TSD Research

**More content is coming.** Additional articles will address TSD measurement and slope integration, direct deflection-slope backcalculation, full-truck modeling, flexible- versus rigid-pavement response, dimensional analysis, and the DSteele machine-learning surrogate.
